name: Diaries of the Doomguy
source:
This photo-journal was found in a demon-infested lab on Phobos. It contains the Doomguy's last thoughts, most of which are, not surprisingly, pretty close to that Doom Comic!

[From [url=http://www.glorioustrainwrecks.com/node/760]Glorious Trainwrecks[/url]]
translation:
这本照片日记是在被恶魔侵占的火卫一实验室里发现的。它记录了毁灭战士最后的想法，其中大部分内容果然与那部《毁灭战士漫画》非常相似！

[译自[url=http://www.glorioustrainwrecks.com/node/760]Glorious Trainwrecks[/url]]
